method: Production catalogue (built on all 11,868) + production calibrated LR applied to KMVALIDATION2025 DNA variants from CRyPTIC v3.4.0 MUTATIONS.parquet (Zenodo 15680920, CC-BY 4.0). 792 isolates, ZERO training overlap. Compared to lab phenotype (35 R/757 S).
interpretation: EXTERNAL test on 792 non-overlapping isolates: catalogue sens_firm 0.7917 / spec_firm 0.9881; model AUC 0.8682, binary sens 0.8571 / spec 0.7728. Stratified by lineage in tables.
caveats: SENSITIVITY ANALYSIS, not headline proof: KM assay/CC UNDOCUMENTED (MEDIUM quality). Only 35 resistant -> wide sensitivity CI. No Indian external resistant isolates exist. Production model has NOT seen these isolates (zero overlap verified). match != beat.
supports: First external evaluation of a BDQ triage tool on non-overlapping isolates (KM cohort).
